result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection equipped with basic pedestrian infrastructure, including a marked zebra crosswalk, pedestrian signals, and continuous sidewalks. However, the wide roadway and lack of physical traffic calming measures or a median refuge increase pedestrian exposure during crossing.

hazards.name: Wide crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross a wide expanse of asphalt without a mid-block refuge island, increasing exposure time to traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Center left, across the main roadway at the zebra markings

hazards.name: Visibility obstruction
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection may block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curb line near the crosswalk and row houses

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the intersection corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility for both pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles receive a green light.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Add street trees along the curb to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway, which also helps slow traffic.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalks and a pedestrian refuge island equipped with a signal. While basic infrastructure is present, the wide roadway and lack of physical traffic calming measures create a high-exposure environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Wide Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic, including a turn lane, which increases exposure time to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway.

hazards.name: Minimal Refuge Protection
hazards.description: The pedestrian refuge island is narrow and lacks substantial physical barriers to protect waiting pedestrians from moving traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway at the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to reduce the crossing distance and improve sight lines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Raised Crosswalk
interventions.description: Elevate the crosswalk to sidewalk level to slow approaching vehicles and increase the visibility of pedestrians.

interventions.title: Hardened Refuge Island
interventions.description: Upgrade the painted refuge area to a wider, raised concrete island with robust bollards for better physical protection.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalks and paved sidewalks, providing a basic level of pedestrian infrastructure adjacent to a recreational field. However, the lack of dedicated pedestrian signals and the wide, unmarked roadway increase exposure and potential for vehicle-pedestrian conflicts.

hazards.name: Sun Glare
hazards.description: Intense sun glare from the horizon may significantly reduce driver visibility of pedestrians entering the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Upper right quadrant of the sky

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: The absence of pedestrian-specific signal heads forces walkers to rely on vehicle signals, which may not provide sufficient clearance intervals.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to improve predictability and safety for people crossing.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Implement bulb-outs to reduce the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles at the intersection.

interventions.title: Advanced Stop Bars
interventions.description: Add stop bars set back from the crosswalk to improve sight lines between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalks and pedestrian signals within a residential context. However, the wide roadway and lack of a median refuge island result in a long unprotected crossing distance for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a mid-block refuge, increasing exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the foreground

hazards.name: Wide Travel Lanes
hazards.description: The width of the asphalt may encourage higher vehicle speeds in a residential area.
hazards.location_in_image: Main roadway through the center of the image

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide street in two stages.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles get a green light.
